items.summary: Recommendation: reject all production, queue, revenue, ROI, margin, and causal-lift work this cycle. Attribution is aggregate or low-volume, the revenue window is one day, budgets and fixed costs are unspecified, operations sweeps are unavailable, and zero outcomes are proven. Preserve only one bounded public readiness assessment for offshorehookup.com, with no telemetry, credentials, configuration, spending, schedules, or production changes. Authorize that assessment?
